about: Every build in The Hollow Crown, designed or not. Add an entry the moment a build is asked for, even with no design yet, and move its status on as it progresses. Run  node tools/build-catalog.mjs  after editing to rewrite builds/CATALOG.md (check.mjs fails if it is stale).

statuses.designed: a design, spec or render exists (Claude Doc, hosted 3D page, or code on a branch), but not in the local asset viewer from main
statuses.in viewer: a builder on main shows it in the asset viewer (localhost:4747), not yet placed by the game
statuses.in game: the game (or the world map) places it

regions.everwake: Everwake, the city in the sky

builds.name: The Twelve Gates, the arena at Kingsrest: 12 coloured starting rooms, round stands, royal box, gatehouse
builds.notes: Round amphitheatre: a round fighting floor 61 across in a round Norman shell 117 across, south-west of the grand station; 12 rooms every 30 degrees in the settlement colours with portcullis gates, loadout racks and a lectern board; 25 round rows of stands lit for night, royal box, four round stair towers with copper domes on the diagonals, gatehouse with the challenge boards; terraformed, with a paved way to the station. Fight code: arena fights thread (PR #310). World blocks map/arena-blocks.json, positions map/arena-layout.json.
